subject: RetailCo trial: onboarding roadmap, acceptance criteria, and kickoff dates
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Zhou <maggie.zhou@retailco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15 09:12 PST
Subject: Follow-up & proposed onboarding roadmap after today's demo

Hi Maggie —

Really enjoyed the call this morning. Thanks for walking us through the primary readout stakeholders and the two concrete success criteria you outlined (85% intent-classification accuracy on your sampled test set; 40% reduction in human review volume for high-touch returns flow). Per our chat, I pulled together a compact onboarding roadmap and a set of measurable acceptance gates we can use during the 6-week trial.

Key highlights (high level):
- Kickoff week (Week 0): environment access, baseline data snapshot, security checklist review (SOC questionnaire requested).
- Week 1–2: ingest + mapping of the returns dataset, first-pass model tuning, baseline metrics.
- Week 3–4: targeted prompts, caching and batching config, live A/B in shadow mode for a subset of SKUs.
- Week 5: final model tuning, runbook for handoffs, training for analyst team.
- Week 6: final readout, acceptance gate review, formal recommendation and next-steps (Dedicated capacity or hosted contract).

Owners:
- Redwood technical lead: Connor O'Brien (cc'd) — runtime integration, metrics collection, KV caching config.
- Redwood CS / evaluation: Marissa Cole — success criteria validation and readout.
- Procurement / commercial: Rachel Kim — contract and trial licensing.
- RetailCo PM: Maggie Zhou — acceptance sign-off and test data.

I've attached a one-tab onboarding roadmap (trial_onboarding_roadmap_v1.xlsx) and the mutual action plan draft. Can you confirm:
1) that the two acceptance criteria above capture your objectives,
2) whether Daniel (engineering) needs a separate network/VPN install window (we'll need 2 hours of coordinated time), and
3) whether Nov 30 or Dec 2 works better for the kickoff?

Next steps (if we get your confirmation): I'll schedule the kickoff and share a short checklist for your infra team ahead of time.

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0122

Attachments: trial_onboarding_roadmap_v1.xlsx; mutual_action_plan_retailco.docx
From: Maggie Zhou <maggie.zhou@retailco.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@retailco.com>, RetailCo IT <it@retailco.com>
Date: 2026-11-15 11:04 PST
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed onboarding roadmap after today's demo

Thanks, Avery — great recap and that timeline looks reasonable. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Acceptance criteria — yes, both items are correct. Small ask: add a secondary qualitative gate around false-positive review rate for flagged returns (we want false positives under 5% for urgent workflows).
2) Daniel will coordinate the network window. He asked if the integration can start in 'shadow' mode without a persistent VPN (we can provide secure S3 access).
3) Kickoff: Dec 2 works best for the RetailCo product team.

I'll loop in our procurement lead offline for the MAP and any contract questions. Also attaching our completed portion of the security questionnaire — some items marked as 'pending' where we need redwood input.

Maggie
Maggie Zhou
Director, Product Operations
RetailCo
maggie.zhou@retailco.com

Attachments: retailco_security_questionnaire.pdf
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Zhou <maggie.zhou@retailco.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16 08:27 PST
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed onboarding roadmap after today's demo

Hi Maggie —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the false-positive threshold. We can add that as a measurable gate in Week 5 (post-A/B shadow evaluation). A couple technical notes in response to questions:

- Shadow integration approach: S3-based payloads work fine. We'll need a short handshake (signed token) and an agreed sample cadence (we typically start at 1 req/s for the first 48 hours, then scale up).
- Network/VPN: good to avoid a maintenance window if we can. If RetailCo can host a temporary S3 bucket and share presigned URLs for uploads, our runtime will pull the payloads securely. If you prefer socket ingress, we'll schedule the 2-hour window during kickoff week.
- Data retention: by default we'll keep trial logs for 30 days unless you request otherwise — we can adjust if needed.

I'll prepare a short 'integration checklist' for your infra people and post it in the shared Drive folder.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Technical Lead, Integrations
Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Maggie Zhou <maggie.zhou@retailco.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17 09:40 PST
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed onboarding roadmap after today's demo — licensing & MAP

Hi Maggie —

Looping in on commercial details. Per our standard trial terms: 6-week evaluation, no charge for hosted compute up to 10k inference units/day, onboarding support included (up to 12 engineer hours). If you need a longer trial or reserved capacity during the test we'll put together a short addendum.

Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan with the commercial bullets filled in. Two quick asks for procurement:
- Signer name and email for the MAP (we usually E-sign the MAP to establish trial scope).
- Any PO or internal approval timeline we should be aware of before the final readout.

If Dec 2 kickoff is confirmed, I'll plan to have the MAP E-sent the week of Nov 30 so the procurement team can review ahead of the trial start.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_retailco.docx
From: Maggie Zhou <maggie.zhou@retailco.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-18 16:03 PST
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed onboarding roadmap after today's demo — confirmed kickoff

Avery / team —

Dec 2 confirmed for kickoff (10:00am PT). Daniel will create the S3 temp bucket and send presigned URL details by Nov 30. Our procurement lead is Sarah Lim (sarah.lim@retailco.com) and she'll expect the MAP via DocuSign — you can send to her directly.

We reviewed the acceptance gates internally and the additional false-positive threshold is acceptable. We'll also provide the product analyst to join weekly Wednesday check-ins (30 min).

Please go ahead and lock the calendar invite for Dec 2 and share the infra checklist. Thanks — excited to get started.

Maggie
